title: Change tracking with a Proxy
hints: `set(obj, key, value, receiver)` checks the types when `key in obj`, pushes the change, then `return Reflect.set(obj, key, value, receiver);` (lesson 7.03).
A trap must return `true` for success; throwing a `TypeError` yourself gives a clearer message than returning `false`.
requirements: A new value must have the same `typeof` as the old one (new properties may have any type).
`changes(proxy)` returns the list of changes; keep the lists in a `WeakMap` from proxy to list.
Use `Reflect.set` and `Reflect.deleteProperty` to do the real work.
stretch: Add an `undo(proxy)` that reverses the last change.
